latest_release.body:
## 📦 特性（feat）

- [feat(runtime): 鸿蒙ASCF元服务支持分栏模式适配](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19605) - @txazo
- [feat(weapp): support scrollIntoViewOffset on ScrollView](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19624) - @officialasishkumar
- [feat(h5): support getSelectedTextRange](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19647) - @Jarvis636431
- [feat(h5): support gyroscope APIs on H5](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19633) - @officialasishkumar

## 🐛 修复（fix）

- [fix(h5): keep request cancellable while reading response bodies](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19598) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): report a meaningful errMsg when previewImage fails to load an image](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19607) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(shared): correct return type of createPullDownComponent hook](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19603) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(router): correct framework param type of createRouter/createMultiRouter](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19601) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): call WeChat JS-SDK once in processOpenApi](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19600) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): stop leaking transitionend listeners and breaking animation steps](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19609) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): isolate each chooseLocation call and settle it only once](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19611) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(taro-components-advanced): avoid updating state while VirtualWaterfall/VirtualList render](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19612) - @officialasishkumar
- [fix(taro-components): keep Video progress ball draggable inside ScrollView on H5](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19613) - @officialasishkumar
- [fix(router): show back button on the H5 home page when there are pages to go back to](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19614) - @officialasishkumar
- [fix(h5): report viewport dimensions in onWindowResize](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19616) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): prefer scrollTop in pageScrollTo](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19622) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): settle interrupted page scrolls](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19618) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): report missing page scroll targets](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19620) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): preserve descendant semantics in selector queries](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19626) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): clean up media query observer listeners](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19628) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(types): add alipay success field to Taro.setStorage result type](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19629) - @jay23606
- [fix(router): 修复快速返回导致的 H5 白屏](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19630) - @CrayonPig
- [fix(router): avoid duplicated ? in multi-mode page urls](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19631) - @officialasishkumar
- [fix(h5): settle upload and download setup failures](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19637) - @Jarvis636431
- [fix(h5): keep toast, modal and action sheet above the page while fading](https://github.com/NervJS/taro/pull/19632) - @officialasishkumar
